clue.text: Separate act he'd developed

indicators.note: developed suggests something worked up into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's theatrical piece has grown into a standalone act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' rearranges ACTHED, the letters of 'act he'd'.
explanation.definitionFit: To separate two things is to disconnect or unfasten them.

clue.text: All can, that is to say, be formed into an association

indicators.note: be formed into signals the listed letters being shaped into something new

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is to say

explanation.surface: Everyone can, so to speak, be organised into a club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be formed into' rearranges ALL + CAN + IE (ALLCANIE).
explanation.definitionFit: An alliance is a union or pact formed between parties for mutual benefit.

clue.text: Feverishness experienced during hot weather

definitions.meaning: a fever shows as a raised body heat
in a heatwave the thermometer reads high

explanation.definitionFit: A fever is a raised body heat, and a heatwave brings high readings on the thermometer.

clue.text: Order player from the field with a friendly demonstration of goodwill

definitions.meaning: a referee dismisses a player for foul play
a farewell party or gathering for someone leaving

explanation.definitionFit: A referee dismisses a player by this phrase, and the noun is a farewell celebration for someone departing.

clue.text: Little to see on television that is unattractive?

definitions.meaning: few watchable programmes on the box

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally means scarcely anything worth watching, and idiomatically describes someone plain or unappealing in looks.

clue.text: It gives a loud report of the said clergyman

indicators.note: the said means as spoken, so the clergyman's title is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a canon is a clergyman attached to a cathedral

explanation.surface: Gossip about a churchman reported loudly.
explanation.walkthrough: A canon is a cathedral clergyman; 'the said' turns his title into its sound-alike. 'report' is the bang of a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A big gun fires with a loud bang, report being the noise of a shot.

clue.text: Got up a Roman garment

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

explanation.surface: Someone dressed up in classical costume.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns GOT into TOG; add A.
explanation.definitionFit: Citizens of ancient Rome wore a draped woollen robe over the tunic.

clue.text: We will be shortly when we recover

definitions.text: We will be shortly when we recover

parts.words: We will be shortly when we recover
parts.note: the contraction of 'we will' is also how we are once recovered from illness

explanation.surface: A promise that we will be back to health before long.
explanation.definitionFit: The contraction of we will is spelt like the adjective for healthy, the state after recovery.

clue.text: I take this abroad to be a frozen concoction

explanation.surface: A traveller says they take this along to make a chilled drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' asks for a foreign word: French 'ce' means this.
explanation.definitionFit: Frozen water, or a frozen dessert, is a chilled treat.

clue.text: Skilful speaker in for a torrid time

indicators.note: in says the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A good speaker facing a hard time.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhetorician or public speaker is one who speaks with eloquence.

clue.text: Showy rig has collapsed

indicators.note: collapsed suggests a structure falling apart, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A flashy oil rig has fallen down.
explanation.definitionFit: Garish describes something gaudy or loud in appearance.

clue.text: Frenzied sort of comedian

indicators.note: sort of hints at a version of the word, its letters sorted afresh

explanation.surface: A manic type of stand-up comic.
explanation.definitionFit: Possessed by a devil, hence wildly frantic or crazed.

clue.text: Different view backing the players

definitions.meaning: a new place or outlook, such as a holiday gives
the painted backdrop behind actors on stage being swapped

explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically a fresh environment, and literally the stagehands swapping the backdrop behind the actors.

clue.text: The French way to feel remorse

explanation.definitionFit: A street in France is a rue, and to rue something is to regret it.

clue.text: Written acknowledgment concerning the said seat

indicators.note: the said means as spoken, so the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a place to sit, pronounced like the end of the answer

explanation.surface: A note confirming something about a reserved seat.
explanation.walkthrough: RE (concerning) plus a syllable sounding like 'seat', spelt CEIPT.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip given as proof that payment or goods were received.

clue.text: Shocking swimmer?

parts.note: not a scandalous bather but a fish that delivers electric shocks

explanation.definitionFit: The electric species of this snakelike fish stuns prey with a jolt.

clue.text: Label that will not come off?

definitions.meaning: one who sticks fast and persists

explanation.definitionFit: An adhesive tag, and also a person or thing that clings on stubbornly.

clue.text: Many taking on search for a win

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral 100, a large number

explanation.surface: Lots of people setting out on a hunt hoping for victory.
explanation.walkthrough: C (Roman 100) for 'Many', then ON, then QUEST.
explanation.definitionFit: A conquest is a victory, the act of defeating an opponent.

clue.text: Woman of parts

parts.note: not a talented lady but one who plays roles on stage

explanation.definitionFit: A female performer is cast in roles, or parts.

clue.text: Currently it contributes to a comfortable retirement

definitions.text: Currently it contributes to a comfortable retirement

parts.words: Currently it contributes to a comfortable retirement
parts.note: warmth from an electrical current helps one go cosily to bed

explanation.definitionFit: A heated bed cover powered by mains current keeps a sleeper warm at bedtime.

clue.text: Struggle to search thoroughly at the finish

parts.note: to comb is to search thoroughly

explanation.surface: A hard effort to hunt carefully until the end.
explanation.walkthrough: COMB (search thoroughly) with AT at the finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Combat is fighting, a struggle between opponents.

clue.text: Make possible the production of baleen

indicators.note: the production of means something made out of these letters

explanation.walkthrough: 'the production of' rearranges BALEEN, the whalebone from a whale's mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: To enable is to allow or empower something to happen.

clue.text: Travelling clock?

parts.note: not a portable timepiece but an instrument that clocks up distance travelled

explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle's mileage meter records distance covered, and to clock is slang for registering miles.

clue.text: Two-way legal transaction

indicators.note: two-way says the word reads identically in both directions

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A contract working in both directions.
explanation.definitionFit: A signed legal document conveying property or rights is a deed.

clue.text: A ring-curl developed that is visual

indicators.note: developed suggests something worked into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: A ringlet of hair forming before one's eyes.
explanation.definitionFit: Ocular relates to the eye or to sight.

clue.text: Go about two

explanation.surface: Someone tells a couple to move around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go' in the sense 'repair to the bar', to betake oneself somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: To repair to a place is to go or withdraw there.

clue.text: Mineral spring in southern Pennsylvania

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for Pennsylvania

explanation.surface: A source of mineral water in the south of a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: A resort town with a medicinal mineral spring, like Bath, gives its name to such springs.

clue.text: But this game cannot be played by one alone

definitions.text: But this game cannot be played by one alone

parts.words: But this game cannot be played by one alone
parts.note: the card game's name means single-handed, yet it needs four players

explanation.definitionFit: Solo whist takes its name from a lone bid but needs four players at the table.
